A clean chart showing the seven clause patterns as rows of coloured blocks. Each row has a pattern code on the left (SV, SVO, SVC, SVA, SVOO, SVOC, SVOA) and coloured blocks for each element with the example words inside: Subject blocks in blue, Verb blocks in red, Object blocks in green, Complement blocks in purple, Adverbial blocks in orange. Example rows: "The baby | cried"; "Chika | ate | the moi-moi"; "The moi-moi | was | delicious"; "My father | is | in the office"; "Mama | gave | me | some akara"; "The students | elected | Bola | prefect"; "She | put | the money | in her purse". A small colour key at the bottom: S = Subject, V = Verb, O = Object, C = Complement, A = Adverbial. Flat textbook style, white background.
